semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: The same actual recursive state supplies played point, selected support and inclusive energy. Source time1..T maps to Lean0..T-1; terminal source x_(T+1) is Lean outputT. The loss is proper extended-real and subdifferentiable on a nonempty closed convex finite-dimensional real inner-product domain; legal feedback is required only at actual played points. Fixed SupportPolicy receives time, played point, current loss and strict-past history; it is not reselected for different futures. OracleLaw is a separate stronger sufficient interface. No executable/measurable policy or universal off-path support law is asserted. Empty horizon, zero energy and D=0 are retained; zero selected feedback explicitly skips the projection update. Separate source-display repair, not a change to the original PDF or regret inequality: for B(eta)=D^2/(2eta)+eta*S/2 on eta>0, the infimum is D*sqrt(S) for every D,S>=0. It is attained exactly when both D,S are positive or both are zero. When both are positive the unique minimizer is D/sqrt(S); when both are zero every positive eta minimizes; when exactly one vanishes the infimum0 is unattained. Theorem4.14 displayed minimum must therefore be read as infimum in the one-zero regimes. S is the energy realized by the single adaptive run, frozen during this scalar comparison; no optimal rerun or clairvoyant learner is asserted. Historical staged reviews retained; current independent reviews and exact integration review pending; no runtime model attestation.
